text:
- `formatAdminReport` takes one parameter `admin`: an object with `name`, `email`, `lastLogin`.
- The banner is exactly 40 `=` characters.
- Banner layout is the same as the user report: banner, then `Report for <name> <<email>>`, then banner, then the body line, then a closing banner.
- The body line for the admin report is `Last login: <lastLogin>` (in place of the visits line).
- The result must start and end with the 40-char banner.
- `formatAdminReport` must be exported, and `formatUserReport` must keep working.
